verdict: Grader spread of 6-9 points (out of 12) on most cells — kimi-low alone got 12/12 from gemini, 10/12 from step-5, 10/12 from v4pro, 5/12 from luna, 4/12 from sonnet. With 5 graders the finding is now robust: model-quality rankings are grader-dominated. glm has the LOWEST grader spread (2-4) — it is the most grader-robust candidate, which strengthens the main-model choice independent of which grader you believe. kimi's apparent lead exists only under lenient graders (gemini/step-5/v4pro); under luna/sonnet it collapses. Caveat: v4pro graded its own family (deepseek answers) — treat its deepseek scores as biased; glm cells were only graded by 3 graders. Practice: any single-grader 'model A beats model B' claim in this lab is now downgraded to indicative; majority-of-3 across DIFFERENT families is the new bar (majority column in e08b-three-graders.json is contaminated for deepseek cells by the family conflict).
